runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one 1024 x 1024 RGBA transparent PNG, an albedo texture-source painting of the LEFT side of the Lowfolk salvage palisade. Image 1 (guide_left.png) is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry authority. Image 2 (design_reference.png) is ONLY the approved material and colour reference; do not copy its camera or lighting.
Paint over image 1 without moving any edges. Preserve its EXACT silhouette, internal openings, every shape edge, size, position and generous transparent margins. The narrow end-on orthographic structure occupies approximately x337–686 and y291–734 on the 1024 canvas. Keep this small centered scale: do not enlarge or reframe it. Preserve the irregular differences in the left guide. Do not convert it into a frontal or three-quarter wall.
Change only the grey surface materials: rust-brown and grey steel girders, cross straps and diagonal braces, mottled worn steel sheets, chipped off-white ceramic plates with muted gold edges where present, and dull grey ash bags and debris at the foot, matching the design reference. Surface rivets and rust are painted details, never additional silhouette geometry. Maintain every existing opening and brace placement. No added objects, no extra spikes.
LIGHTING: flat, even, shadowless light from the viewer. This is unlit diffuse BASE COLOUR / ALBEDO for projection onto the existing 3D mesh. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Paint rust and chips as intrinsic colour, not lighting. No background, floor, gradient, halo, text or watermark. Transparent background including guide openings. Return exactly 1024 x 1024 with original guide outline and placement unchanged.
runs.reason: Rejected: enlarged object, altered geometry, wrong canvas size, residual shading.
